public.title: Reverse Integer
public.description: Reverse the decimal digits of a signed 32-bit integer, preserving the sign and discarding leading zeros. Return zero if the reversed result is outside signed 32-bit range.
hints: Reverse the magnitude before restoring the sign.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Reverse the decimal magnitude, restore sign, and check both 32-bit bounds before returning. Time and space O(number of digits).
